svg.aria-label: Cairn, a document-grounded RAG platform, in active development. Organize documents into workspaces and projects, ask questions over any slice of them, and get answers where every claim traces back to a source page or line range. Built with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Docker, Nginx, Prometheus, Grafana, Gemini, SQLAlchemy, and Pydantic.

svg.text: Organize documents into workspaces and projects, ask questions over any slice of them,
and get answers where every claim traces back to a source page or line range.
The same documents also generate quizzes, flashcards, charts, and diagrams.
